slides.headline: The parcel invoice check *most brands skip*
slides.sub: Shipping prices are at a record this quarter. 6 lines to check before peak eats your margin.

slides.title: Fuel surcharges
slides.body: Since 2021, 72 in 100 of the rise came from carrier pricing, not diesel.
slides.cost: Check: surcharge rate vs your contract

slides.title: Peak surcharges
slides.body: They run on set dates. Make sure they start and stop when they should.
slides.cost: Check: billed dates vs the carrier's schedule

slides.title: Address corrections
slides.body: A fee each time the carrier fixes an address. Was it really wrong?
slides.cost: Check: corrected addresses vs your orders

slides.title: Residential fees
slides.body: Easy to charge on a business address by mistake.
slides.cost: Check: fee type vs the ship-to address

slides.title: Dimensional weight
slides.body: Billed on box size, not weight. 1 wrong measurement repeats on every order.
slides.cost: Check: billed size vs your real boxes

slides.title: Duplicate charges
slides.body: The same parcel billed twice. Small on 1 invoice, real across a season.
slides.cost: Illustrative: 50 cents x 5,000 orders = $2,500 a month
